title: Flower Dance
description: DJ OKAWARI 的名曲长笛改编。十六分音符连绵不断，旋律在快速律动中穿行，中段速度提升、织体更密，对手指灵活性与气息稳定都是扎实的考验。
descriptionEn: A celebrated DJ OKAWARI piece arranged for flute. Sixteenth notes flow without pause as the melody threads through quick figuration, and the mid-section lifts in tempo and texture — a solid test of finger agility and steady breath.
